subject: Quantile Labs MSA + Order Form — intake & party factsheet
messages:
From: Lucas Rivera <lucas.rivera@quantile-labs.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elaine Park <elaine@quantile-labs.com>
Date: 2025-06-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: New customer intake: MSA + initial order form

Hi Mina / Kimberly,

Thanks for onboarding us — attaching a first-pass Order Form for Redwood to review. We're keen to align on the MSA baseline and get a target go-live for pilot traffic in Q3. Quick context: Quantile Labs is an analytics startup processing model outputs containing hashed user IDs. We prefer a 12-month initial term and will likely want SOC2 evidence and a short data retention carveout for logs.

Attached: Quantile_OrderForm_Draft-20250620.docx and a small roster (Quantile_Company_Roster.xlsx). Can you confirm what party data you need (legal names, billing contact, signatory) and whether Redwood needs an IP exhibit? Also flag any non-starters from Redwood's standard Order Form.

Best,
Lucas
Head of Partnerships
Quantile Labs

Attachments: Quantile_OrderForm_Draft-20250620.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document), Quantile_Company_Roster.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Lucas Rivera <lucas.rivera@quantile-labs.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-06-20T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New customer intake: MSA + initial order form

Hi Lucas — welcome and thanks for the materials. I did a quick skim and outlined next steps below so we can keep the intake tight:

1) Party factsheet: please confirm the legal entity name exactly as it should appear on the MSA, billing address, and the requested signatory name + title. The roster looks helpful, but we need billing contact + tax info for order form generation.

2) Security evidence: SOC 2 report and any customer-facing security whitepapers are required for our standard review. Can you share a link or copy?

3) Term & SLOs: your ask for a 12-month term is noted. Do you have minimum throughput or monthly committed tokens we should reflect on the Order Form?

4) IP & data retention: Redwood's standard MSA doesn't assign customer-generated model outputs to Redwood; if you need an IP exhibit, say so and we'll route to legal for custom language. For retention, we typically hold request logs for 30 days by default; we can propose a short-term extension for pilot telemetry.

5) Redlines: please highlight any clauses in your version that you expect to change. If you prefer, we can circulate Redwood's standard MSA + a filled Order Form template for side-by-side redlines.

I'll loop Marissa (contracts) for any deviations from our templates. Kimberley, could you run a quick templating check and confirm whether the order form maps cleanly to our billing fields?

Next milestone: I'll prepare an intake summary and our standard MSA + order form template by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Senior Legal Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

--
Mina Haddad | Senior Legal Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0118

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Lucas Rivera <lucas.rivera@quantile-labs.com>
Date: 2025-06-21T08:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New customer intake: MSA + initial order form

Thanks Mina. Quick notes from contract's side after a glance at the draft:

- Billing mapping: the draft references "monthly active tokens" which we don't capture directly. Kimberly, confirm whether we should set a proxy metric (e.g., "API units") or request Quantile to align to token counts.
- Liability cap: their draft uses a 12-month cap tied to fees. That's usually a starting point but we will propose our standard cap.
- Data retention/telemetry: we can offer a 90-day retention option for the pilot (with associated cost uplift).
- Exhibits: no immediate need for an IP exhibit unless Quantile identifies specific IP concerns.

Action items for Quantile (cc'd):
- Please provide final legal entity name + billing address + signatory.
- If SOC2 is available, a redacted report or SOC2 type II date is sufficient to move faster.
- Callout any clauses you expect to push back on (liability, indemnity, data residency).

I'll draft a redline of the Order Form to align billing fields and circulate both our MSA + order form template. Planning to share by 2025-06-23 COB.

Marissa Cole
Contracts Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

From: Elaine Park <elaine@quantile-labs.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-06-24T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New customer intake: MSA + initial order form

Hi Marissa / Mina — thanks for the rapid responses. A few quick replies: 

- Legal name: Quantile Labs, Inc.
- Billing address: 810 Market St, Suite 210, San Francisco, CA 94103
- Signatory: Aaron Kim, CFO (aaron.kim@quantile-labs.com)
- SOC2: we completed a SOC2 Type II in March 2025 — I'll share a redacted copy via the Drive link shortly.
- Throughput: for pilot planning assume ~1.5M tokens/month; we'll give a 60-day notice if ramp is faster.

We reviewed Redwood's default exhibits in the onboarding doc and don't require an IP exhibit right now. Liability cap language is something our GC flagged; happy to see Redwood's standard position and iterate.

Attaching the company roster again to include billing contact. Looking forward to the Order Form redline.

Best,
Elaine
Operations, Quantile Labs

Attachments referenced: Quantile_Company_Roster.xlsx
